decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development of rear roof extension and 2 front roof lights and one rear roof light shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plans approved relate only to the roof extension that is the subject of this application and to no other extensions
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the wallS of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of 2 x rooflights to front roof slope and a rear roof extension with 1 x rooflight to rear roof slope of the house.
